item.title: Madison County family demanding answers and transparency after inmate's death
item.description: A family is demanding transparency and accountability after 42-year-old Dion Watts died at UK Hospital four days after they say he sustained severe injuries while in custody at the MCDC.

item.title: Lexington’s lost chord: Restoring the Kentucky Theatre’s historic Wurlitzer pipe organ
item.description: You can imagine the scene at the Kentucky Theatre when it first opened its doors in 1922: A silent film debuts as a Wurlitzer pipe organ fills the auditorium with music and special effects.

item.title: Sen. Mitch McConnell hospitalized for 'flu-like symptoms' Monday evening
item.description: Kentucky Senator Mitch McConnell was hospitalized on Monday evening for "flu-like" symptoms, spokesman David Popp told NBC News.
